valid.complete-empty-quarantine-index.json: Complete bounded discovery may validly produce zero entries.

invalid.unsupported-snapshot-algorithm.json: The versioned snapshot algorithm is fixed.
invalid.complete-with-limitation.json: Complete authorization coverage cannot list limitations.
invalid.absolute-entry-path.json: Source paths are lexical workspace-relative evidence.
invalid.unknown-projection-kind.json: Projection kinds use the accepted closed vocabulary.

digest-mismatch.json.description: The declared digest must match the versioned canonical snapshot encoding.

entries-not-deterministically-sorted.jso.description: Source entries must use deterministic path-first ordering.

duplicate-source-path.json.description: A snapshot cannot contain contradictory observations for one source path.
